2607.01136.title: Skills Are Not Islands: Measuring Dependency and Risk in Agent Skill Supply Chains
2607.01136.paper_summary: Agent skills package reusable operational knowledge for Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet as they grow in scope, they become dependency-bearing artifacts whose identities, versions, and provenance remain implicit. This opacity already causes duplicated dependencies and inconsistent installations, exposing a gap that dependency management has yet to close. We introduce Agent Skill Supply Chains (ASSCs) to characterize mixed skill-package-service dependency graphs and help close this gap. Borrowing from Software Bill of Materials (SBOMs), we design SkillDepAnalyzer to capture natural-language dependency evidence and model skills as dependency-bearing artifacts. On the SKILL-DEP benchmark, SkillDepAnalyzer recovers skill metadata and dependency graphs accurately and comprehensively, substantially outperforming an LLM-based baseline and package-centric SBOM tools. Applying SkillDepAnalyzer to over 1.43 million skills, we obtain ASSCs and explore their structural diversity and security signals. We find four structural patterns: skill metadata is activation-ready but governance-poor; dependency graphs span skill, package, and service dependencies with concentrated reuse; recursive skill reuse expands dependency graphs and creates hidden package inventory; and skill dependency clusters form around related workflows. We also find that inspecting a skill alone misses security-relevant signals hiding in its dependencies. By analyzing ASSCs, we identify and report known malicious skills persisting in ASSCs to their developers. Based on these findings, we recommend typed dependency manifests, first-class dependency-cluster management, risk-warning audit commands for skill infrastructure maintainers, and lockfile-like records for skill developers.
2607.01136.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能包可重用大型語言模型（LLM）代理的操作知識，但隨著其範圍的擴大，它們成為帶有依賴性的工件，其身份、版本和來源仍然隱含。這種不透明性已經導致了重複的依賴性和不一致的安裝，暴露出依賴管理尚未彌補的差距。我們引入了代理技能供應鏈（ASSCs）來表徵混合技能包服務依賴圖，並幫助彌補這一差距。借鑒軟件材料清單（SBOMs），我們設計了SkillDepAnalyzer，以捕捉自然語言依賴證據並將技能建模為帶有依賴性的工件。在SKILL-DEP基準上，SkillDepAnalyzer準確且全面地恢復技能元數據和依賴圖，顯著超越基於LLM的基準和以包為中心的SBOM工具。將SkillDepAnalyzer應用於超過143萬個技能，我們獲得了ASSCs並探索其結構多樣性和安全信號。我們發現四種結構模式：技能元數據是啟用就緒但治理不足；依賴圖跨越技能、包和服務依賴，重用集中；遞歸技能重用擴展依賴圖並創造隱藏的包庫存；技能依賴集群圍繞相關工作流程形成。我們還發現，單獨檢查一個技能會錯過隱藏在其依賴中的與安全相關的信號。通過分析ASSCs，我們識別並報告了持續存在於ASSCs中的已知惡意技能給其開發者。根據這些發現，我們建議使用類型化依賴清單、一流的依賴集群管理、針對技能基礎設施維護者的風險警告審計命令，以及針對技能開發者的鎖定文件類記錄。
